title: Generated Wasm FFI adapters
objective: Generate production-consumable Wasm FFI adapters and closure manifests for fixed scalars, packed buffers, resources/views, copied-byte transfer, bounded statuses, and memory-growth-safe JavaScript, with focused differential tests

oracles: actual Wasm execution when the pinned WASI toolchain is available

runs.command: node --test test/ffi-wasm-generated-adapters.cjs test/ffi-wasm-resource.cjs test/ffi-wasm-fmpz-resource-core.cjs test/ffi-wasm-fmpq-resource-core.cjs test/ffi-wasm-m4ri-resource.cjs

handoff.summary: Generated a declaration-derived Wasm32 adapter protocol for fixed scalars, packed uint64 and exact-integer buffers, copied byte transfer, owned resources and borrowed views, generation-tagged handles, transactional ingress/egress, bounded statuses, and memory-growth-safe JavaScript. Added a deterministic production closure generator that consumes sagejs.wasm-adapter-inputs/v1, plus focused tests covering the complete declared closure, actual WebAssembly.Memory growth, transactional failure, exact integers, and stale borrowed handles.
risks: The focused real FLINT Wasm differential test is conditional and skipped on this host because the pinned CoWasm/WASI FLINT SDK and libraries are not built; release CI must execute it with the production toolchain.
Manual analytic and number-field-zeta shared cores are intentionally outside the declaration-derived closure and must remain explicit reviewed additional capabilities in the distribution manifest.
next_steps: The distribution/toolchain lane should call generatedWasmClosure(registry, { adapterInputs, strict: true }) and link each returned artifact instead of invoking the single-surface generator directly.
Run the conditional real-Wasm differential tests in pinned Linux x64 and arm64 release builders, then expose the generated closure hash in the production capability manifest.
